en: Black-and-white panoramic view over a hilly, forested rural landscape with scattered farms and houses. A railway line and a small station with several buildings are visible in the right foreground, running through the valley. Text in Norwegian is printed at the bottom of the image, identifying the view near Veldre Station and crediting the photographer/publisher Carl Normann with a date of 1926.
